attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 0 to 36 are spine, in 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 23% of calls. The model names 95% of genes there on average, and its hesitation peaks at column 25, `mltA`, 0.73 bits.

**A single variable column follows**, column 37, `fucP`, in a region of plasticity in 19% of calls, named 94%. Then columns 38 to 53 are spine again, in 90 to 95% of chromosomes, all persistent: the `fuc` genes, `sdaB`, `gudP` to `gudD`, `barA`, `rlmD`. The model names 93% of genes there, but only 45% at column 50, `gudX`.

**The graph opens at column 54.** Columns 54 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 81% of calls. Columns 54 to 59 carry `relA` to `eno`, [[fucose and nucleoside metabolism]]; columns 64 to 76 carry `yqcE` to `cysH`, [[oxidoreductase and sulfite reduction]]. A second branch of 3 families runs through columns 60 to 62, carried by 11 to 15% of chromosomes, each following the previous one.

**Hesitation peaks at column 60**, `ygcG`, 1.29 bits, in a region of plasticity in 65% of calls. The model names 91% of genes across the fork and variable columns, fewest at column 77, 75%. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.83 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 95%.

**The window ends at column 79**, `casB`, carried by 20% of chromosomes, with `casA` and `iap` beside it. The model names 93% of genes in the whole window, 0.28 bits on average.

label: ygeA
facts:
WINDOW: the ygeA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ygeA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 890 to 969 from dnaA. Read in 532 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ygeA once); 42,560 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,943 calls, named 96%, 0.12 bits; shell 9,263 calls, named 86%, 0.74 bits; cloud 354 calls, named 32%, 2.93 bits. Outside an RGP 33,837 calls, named 95%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 8,723 calls, named 85%, 0.83 bits. Columns: 53 spine, 7 fork, 20 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.83 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 95%); 8,723 of the 42,560 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 60 (ygcG) 1.29 bits, RGP 65%; column 78 ("transposase") 1.00 bits, RGP 55%; column 77 (small) 0.87 bits, RGP 49%. The 13 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.60 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 94%, 0.22 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 54-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 3-81%; the least: columns 0-36 (spine), RGP 0-23%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-36 (37 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0-23%. Genes: ygeA "aspartate/glutamate racemase", lysR, lysA "diaminopimelate decarboxylase", galR, aas, lplT, tas, ygdR "YgdI/YgdR family lipoprotein", ygdQ "TerC family protein", mutH, ygdT "protein YgdT", rppH, ptsP, lgt, thyA, ppdA "prepilin peptidase-dependent protein", ppdB, ygdB "DUF2509 family protein", ppdC, recC, ptrA, recB, recD "ATP-binding domain-containing prote…", argA, amiC, mltA, tcdA, csdE, csdA "cysteine desulfurase CsdA", ygdI "YgdI/YgdR family lipoprotein", gcvA, ygdD "DUF423 domain-containing protein", rlmM, fucR "L-fucose operon activator", fucU, fucK, fucI. named 7-100% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 7 (ygdR), named 7%; most hesitant at column 25 (mltA), 0.73 bits.
2. column 37 variable: RGP 19%. named 94%; 0.59 bits.
   37: fucP S 85%
3. columns 38-53 (16 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 3-19%. Genes: fucA, fucO, xni, sdaB, sdaC "HAAAP family serine/threonine perme…", ppnN, queF, syd, yqcC "YqcC family protein", truC, yqcA "flavodoxin", gudP, gudX, gudD "enolase C-terminal domain-like prot…", barA, rlmD. named 45-99% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 50 (gudX), named 45%; most hesitant at column 41 (sdaB), 0.38 bits.
4. columns 54-79 (26 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 3-81%. named 75-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 77, named 75%; most hesitant at column 60, 1.29 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 60-62, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-15%, all S; the branch's families: "TPM domain-containing protein", "hypothetical protein", "LemA family protein"
   columns 54-59 variable, share 78-89%, 4 P, 2 S: relA 89%, mazE 78%, mazF 78%, mazG "nucleoside triphosphate pyrophospho…" 86%, pyrG 86%, eno 85%
   60 fork: ygcG S 65% "TPM domain-containing protein"
   61 fork: yqcG S 48%
   62 fork: queE P 85%
   63 fork: ygcE S 77% "FGGY family carbohydrate kinase"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 19%
   columns 64-76 variable, share 73-80%, 7 S, 6 P: yqcE "MFS transporter" 77%, ygcW "SDR family oxidoreductase" 76%, ygcU "FAD-binding oxidoreductase" 77%, ygcS "MFS transporter" 78%, ygcR "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 79%, ygcQ "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 76%, ygcP "glycerol-3-phosphate responsive ant…" 78%, ygcO "ferredoxin family protein" 78%, ygcN "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase" 75%, queD 80%, cysJ 79%, cysI "NADPH-dependent assimilatory sulfit…" 77%, cysH 73%
   77 fork: small P 41%; also cas3 S 19%
   78 fork: "transposase" S 22%; also cas3 S 20%, casA S 14%
   79 fork: casB S 20%; also casA S 17%, iap P 16%, cas7e S 11%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): ppdB prepilin peptidase-dependent protein; recB UvrD-helicase domain-containing protein; fucU L-fucose mutarotase; fucK L-fuculokinase; fucP L-fucose:H+ symporter permease; fucA L-fuculose-phosphate aldolase; fucO iron-containing alcohol dehydrogenase; sdaB L-serine ammonia-lyase, iron-sulfur-dep…; gudP MFS transporter; mazE type II toxin-antitoxin system antitoxi…; mazF endoribonuclease MazF; cysJ flavodoxin domain-containing protein; cysH phosphoadenosine phosphosulfate reducta…; casA type I-E CRISPR-associated protein Cse1…; cas7e type I-E CRISPR-associated protein Cas7…; casB type I-E CRISPR-associated protein Cse2…; cysD phosphoadenosine phosphosulfate reducta…
END: the window ends at column 79, casB, in 20% of chromosomes.
